items.reason: Detail `s` uses the same container Status menu constructor as the row list.
Detail `y` opens the container Copy menu without copying immediately.
Detail `m` opens the Mute menu for the detail’s container.
Both surfaces dispatch `I` through the shared runShortcutOver helper.
View permits the drain picker to render while the detail remains open.
Direct `y` and `p` dispatch is removed from document peeks.
Bare `p` has no action in either detail list.
Existing item and artifact `r` menu paths remain intact.
The shared status refusal reaches the detail hint line through the dashboard flash fallback.
The shared copy refusal appears on the detail hint line.
The shared mute refusal appears on the detail hint line.
Container menus occupy the detail Frame’s reserved Block and reduce its body budget.
Detail menus reuse the row-list navigation and entry dispatch handlers.
Menu Escape clears the menu without clearing the detail.
Detail openers bypass Selection handling and construct singular menus.
Detail search filters the displayed list, and Enter restores normal detail controls.
Shared filtering implements case-insensitive substring matching with AND-ed terms across id, title and type.
Item search fields exclude status.
Artifact filtering uses the same grammar over name and type.
Escape discards the input buffer and reapplies the previously committed term.
Search opens with an empty buffer, and applying it clears filtering.
The typing handler sends ordinary keys, including `j`, `k`, `v` and `r`, to the text field.
Detail synchronization reapplies the active query after polling.
The detail header displays the applied search term.
Empty search results name the query and explain how to clear it.
Artifact availability uses the complete artifact collection, preserving switching after filtering.
Detail search state is separately owned and discarded when the detail closes.
Detail hints advertise all required menus and search without flat copy bindings.
Peek hints remove flat copy-name and copy-path keys.
Typing hints list only apply, cancel and help.
Detail help lists the menus, applicable `I`, search and conditional clearing; peek help removes flat copies.
Help handles container menus over details and includes a dedicated detail-search typing branch.

scores.rationale: Clear reuse of dispatch, filtering and layout machinery with useful regression tests; modal rendering and help-state coverage remain limited.
